name: Nero AI Image Compressor
author: neroai

sections.description:
AI Image Compressor automatically compresses your images using Nero AI API. It supports batch processing, adjustable quality, and safe handling of your original images. Save bandwidth, speed up your site, and improve SEO with one click!

Features

  • Supports bulk compression for multiple images at once, improving efficiency.
  • Compress images from your media library or upload new files for compression.
  • Clean and intuitive interface for easy management and visual clarity.
  • AI-powered image compression that balances size reduction and quality preservation.
  • Two compression levels: high for maximum size reduction, low for better quality.
  • Displays compression ratio after processing for clear feedback.
  • Compressed images saved as new files; original images remain unchanged.
  • Images stored only locally; Nero AI does not keep user files.
  • Temporary data transfer for compression; no permanent storage on external servers.
  • Compatible with a wide range of image formats including JPG, JPEG, JPE, PNG, WEBP, BMP, JIF, JFI, JFIF, SVG and GIF.

Contact us

If you have any questions, suggestions, or feedback, feel free to reach out at feedback@nero.com.

External services

This plugin connects to the Nero AI API to compress and optimize images. The service is required for the core functionality of image compression.

Service Details:
* Service Provider: Nero AI (https://ai.nero.com)
* Purpose: Image compression and optimization using AI technology
* Data Sent:
– Image files (JPG, JPEG, JPE, PNG, WEBP, BMP, JIF, JFI, JFIF, SVG, GIF) from your WordPress media library and theme directories
– API authentication key for service access
* When Data is Sent:
– During manual bulk processing when you click “Start Bulk Process”
– Each time an individual image compression is requested
* Data Processing: Images are processed on Nero AI’s secure cloud servers and compressed versions are returned to your website

Important Links:
* Service Website: https://ai.nero.com
* Terms of Service: https://ai.nero.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://www.nero.com/eng/corp-legal/privacy.php
* API Documentation: https://ai.nero.com/ai-api/docs

Note: Each image compression consumes 1 Nero Credit from your account. No images are stored permanently on Nero AI servers after processing. All original images remain safely on your server in their original locations.

Compatibility

  • Compatible with WordPress 5.0 and above
  • Works with most themes and media libraries

Author

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard
1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
2. Search for ‘Nero AI Image Compressor’ and click Install Now to install the plugin by Nero AI
3. Once installed, activate the plugin and go to Settings > Nero AI
4. Enter your API key from Nero AI API
5. Choose the image you want to optimize and start compressing your images

From WordPress.org
1. Visit https://wordpress.org/plugins and search for ‘Nero AI Image Compressor’
2. Download the plugin developed by Nero AI
3. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and upload the .zip file
4. Activate the plugin, open Settings > Nero AI, and paste your API key from Nero AI API
5. Select your desired image and begin optimizing them in bulk

Getting started

Install this plugin and create your Nero AI account at Nero AI Official Site to obtain your API key. New users can claim 50 free credits (equivalent to 50 free images) on the Nero AI API page to try compressing images at no cost.

After activation, enter your API key in Settings → AI Image Compressor Bulk Processing and save. You can then select images from your Media Library or upload new ones, choose your preferred compression level (high or low), and start batch processing.

Progress and results of compression will be displayed in a clear list. Typical compression rates reach up to 40%, though actual results vary by image.
sections.faq:
Getting started with Nero AI image Compressor

To begin, register an account at the Nero AI Official Site and get your API Key. Once obtained, enter this key in the plugin settings under Settings > AI Image Compressor Bulk Processing to activate the service.

Free Credits for new users

After created an account, each new account comes with 50 free trial Credits. Visit the Nero AI API Status page, click the “Claim 50 Credits” button, complete a short survey, and the Credits will be automatically added to your account.

Understanding how Credits work

Each image you compress consumes 1 Nero Credit, including any selected thumbnail sizes. You can check your remaining Credits anytime via the Nero AI Dashboard.

Purchasing more Credits

Need more? Visit the Nero AI Pricing Page to explore available Credits packages based on your usage needs.

What exactly is a Credit?

Credits are units used to process images using Nero AI. Normally, 1 image = 1 Credit, regardless of format or size (unless oversized or failed).

Will compression overwrite my original images?

Not at all. Compressed images are saved separately in the nero-ai-image-compressor folder, while your original uploads remain completely untouched.

Supported image formats

The plugin supports:
JPG, JPEG, JPE, PNG, WEBP, BMP, JIF, JFI, JFIF, SVG, GIF

Why isn’t the compression obvious sometimes?

Compression effectiveness depends on the format and content of the image. Some files are already optimized or structurally complex. In those cases, you’ll see a message: “This image can no longer be compressed.”

Generally:
– JPG, JPEG, WEBP often achieve high compression rates
– PNG varies depending on transparency and complexity
– BMP isn’t compressible directly, so it’s converted to JPG for compression

When does compression fail?

Compression might fail due to:
– Images larger than 50MB
– Already optimized images
– Temporary network issues
